# laravelforge_site_push_to_deploy (Resource)

Enables push-to-deploy for a Laravel Forge site. This is a singleton toggle: the presence of the resource means push-to-deploy is enabled, and destroying it disables push-to-deploy. The Forge API exposes no read endpoint for this toggle, so its state is tracked solely by Terraform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site to enable push-to-deploy on.
